Name: Cecilia NPC Visual Tweaks
Author: NexusUser7B2
Description:
Included options so far:
Cecilia tweaks blue skin blue hair
Cecilia tweaks blue skin blue hair with portrait outline
Cecilia tweaks blue skin dark pink hair
Cecilia tweaks blue skin dark pink hair with portrait outline
Cecilia tweaks gray skin yellow hair
Cecilia tweaks gray skin yellow hair with portrait outline
Cecilia tweaks original colors (if you just want the facial tweaks use this)
Cecilia tweaks original colors with portrait outline
Cecilia tweaks white blue skin purple hair
Cecilia tweaks white blue skin purple hair with portrait outline

Installation:
Manual install directly into Cecilia mod:

Folder names and files should allow you to simply overwrite.

1. Download your preferred option.

2. Back up the original Cecilia portraits and spritesheets and Cecilia's kids spritesheets somewhere.

3. Open the Cecilia mod folder and the folder of the option you downloaded.

4. Simply drag or copy/paste the folders '[CP] Cecilia' and '[CP] Cecilia kids' from the download's folder to the Cecilia mod and overwrite all.

4 alt. If you want to make absolutely sure everything gets overwritten go to "[CP] Cecilia\assets\Characters" "[CP] Cecilia\assets\Portraits" and "[CP] Cecilia kids\assets" of the Cecilia mod and the option you chose and drag all of my mod's files from each of these 3 folder into the Cecilia mod's folders of the same names and overwrite.

Mod Organizer 2:
Just click mod manager download, install like usual, set these files after the Cecelia mod, and check to make sure it overwrites the Cecilia mod's portraits and sprites.

Note: Tested with and without these edited files and got the same stuff in the SMAPI logs in regards to the github Cecilia 2.0 version of the mod. If you are having anything show up in the SMAPI logs with the Cecilia mod, my mod should not be the reason. I recommend just going to the Cecilia NPC github page and submitting an issue about the mod and hope the author sees it at some point for whenever they decide to get back into working on the mod.

Permission has been received from the mod author of the Cecilia Custom Ghost NPC mod, whitebalverines
(profile here https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45507937 ), to share these edits.
